# Ubiquiti UniFi Icon Notice

The SVG product artwork in this directory was extracted from the
`Unifi-Network.xml` diagrams.net library published by
`kallsbo/Unifi-Draw.IO` and supplied to InfraStack by the repository owner.

The upstream author states that the icons came from Ubiquiti and that all
rights are retained by Ubiquiti. Ubiquiti, UniFi, and the represented product
names and artwork are trademarks or intellectual property of Ubiquiti Inc.

InfraStack does not claim ownership of the artwork and is not affiliated with,
sponsored by, or endorsed by Ubiquiti. The files were mechanically extracted,
renamed, and optimized for use in editable infrastructure diagrams.

Source: https://github.com/kallsbo/Unifi-Draw.IO
